title: Austin's City Life: Church Sale, Gas Pumps, Health
summary:
*   **Major Property Transaction:** The city agreed to conditionally donate a church building and its contents to the African Methodist Church, pending legal review, as part of a $5,000 land purchase.
*   **New Urban Infrastructure:** A permit was granted for a public gasoline tank and pump on East 5th Street, requiring city engineering oversight and being revocable at any time.
*   **Public Health & Safety Reforms:** The Chief Plumbing Inspector's role was reorganized to fall under the Department of Streets and Public Improvements, and funds were allocated to the Tuberculosis Camp.
*   **Essential City Contracts:** Awards were made for various city supplies, including lumber, groceries, meals for prisoners, and funeral services for the indigent.

The Council was called to order by the Mayor with all members present: The Mayor laid
before the Council the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin : That one hundred and fifty ($ 150.00) dollars be and the same is hereby

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin : That if the City Attorney of the City of Austin shall
report in writing to the City Council that the City Council can legally throw in , as a
part of the consideration of a transfer of the interest, right, title, possession and
claim of the African Methodist Church of this City in and to a lot 69X128 feet at the
corner of West 9th and San Antonio streets , then in that event the City Council agrees ,
in addition to the price of $ 5,000.00, to be paid for the right, title and interest
possession and claim of said African Methodist Church to the property herein above
described it will donate to said African Methodist Church the building erected upon the
lot 69X 128 feet at the corner of West 9th and SanAntonio streets , and all the contents
of the same.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynen & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

Anderson & Benson

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin : That the petition of Anderson & Benson to establish and
maintain in front of the premises at 111-13-15 East 5th street a Gasoline tank with a
gasoline pump attachedbe and the same is hereby granted . The Gasoline Tank herein and
hereby authorized must be placed under the written direction of the City Engineer of this
City, and the pump placed upon the sidewalk curb must like wise be located by the City
Engineer , and the work done under his supervision and approval .
Be it further resolved:
That the permit hereby granted is revocable at any time by the City Council with or
without assignment of any reasons therefor.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved , A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
